extracted.name: Literally the Best Banana Bread
extracted.description: This banana bread is super good and really easy and it always turns out good! It’s based off a recipe book I found at some garage sale with my own additions lol.
ingredient_lines: 1/3 cup melted butter, unsalted or salted it doesn’t matter
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 and butter a bread pan or line it with parchment paper
Mash bananas with the melted butter
Mix in all the other ingredients except the flour, once all of this is mixed add the flour.
Pour the batter in a pan and bake for 45-55 minutes, use a toothpick to check if it’s cooked all the way through.
